facts.fact: Gamtel states it is connected to the ACE (Africa Coast to Europe) submarine fibre cable, with three international gateways totalling 15 Gbps at the time of the page.
Gamtel states two international routes: the ACE submarine cable and a 155 Mbps backup link with Sonatel in Senegal; landing station not named in this document (page date used, as it gives no other).
Gamtel states it holds 49% of the ACE Gambia segment and the remaining 51% is shared among private GSM operators and ISPs, so operators other than Gamtel hold stakes in the Gambian ACE capacity.

systems.owner: ACE consortium; Gamtel 49% of Gambia segment

systems.country_label: 155 Mbps backup link with Sonatel, Senegal
